q.t: How many faces does a cube have?
q.e: Like a dice: top, bottom and four sides.

q.t: How many edges does a cuboid have?
q.e: 4 along the length, 4 along the breadth, 4 along the height.

q.t: How many vertices does a cuboid have?
q.e: 4 corners on top and 4 underneath.

q.t: A football has the shape of a:
q.e: A sphere is perfectly round in every direction.

q.t: An ice-cream cone has the shape of a:
q.e: A circular base narrowing to a point.

q.t: A tin can has the shape of a:
q.e: Two equal circular ends joined by a curved surface.

q.t: A brick has the shape of a:
q.e: Six rectangular faces.

q.t: How many flat faces does a sphere have?
q.e: It has one curved surface and nothing flat.

q.t: How many vertices does a cone have?
q.e: Only its pointed tip.

q.t: The faces of a cube are all:
q.e: All edges of a cube are the same length.

q.t: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
q.e: 2 triangular ends and 3 rectangular sides.

q.t: How many faces does a square pyramid have?
q.e: 1 square base and 4 triangular sides.

q.t: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
q.e: The two circular ends.

q.t: How many edges does a triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) have?
q.e: 3 around the base and 3 rising to the top.

q.t: How many vertices does a triangular prism have?
q.e: 3 at each triangular end.

q.t: How many curved surfaces does a cone have?
q.e: One curved surface, plus one flat circular base.

q.t: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
q.e: 4 around the base and 4 slanting up to the top.

q.t: A cuboid has how many pairs of identical opposite faces?
q.e: Top–bottom, front–back, left–right.

q.t: How many edges meet at each corner of a cuboid?
q.e: One length, one breadth and one height.

q.t: How many faces does a tetrahedron have?
q.e: ‘Tetra’ means four — four triangles.

q.t: How many edges does a triangular prism have?
q.e: 3 on each end (6) plus 3 joining the ends.

q.t: For a cube, find faces + vertices − edges.
q.e: 6 + 8 − 12 = 2. This works for every solid with flat faces (Euler’s rule).

q.t: How many vertices does a pentagonal pyramid have?
q.e: 5 on the base plus the top.

q.t: How many faces does a pentagonal prism have?
q.e: 2 pentagons and 5 rectangles.

q.t: The net of a cube is made of how many squares?
q.e: One for each face.

q.t: A cuboid is 5 cm long, 3 cm wide and 2 cm high. Find the total length of all its edges (in cm).
q.e: There are 4 edges of each size: 4 × (5 + 3 + 2).

q.t: Find the total length of all the edges of a cube of side 4 cm (in cm).
q.e: 12 equal edges.

q.t: On a dice the opposite faces add up to 7. Which number is opposite 2?
How many edges does a hexagonal pyramid have?
q.e: 6 around the base and 6 to the top.

q.t: Looking straight down on a cylinder standing on its end, you see a:
q.e: From above you see only the circular top.

q.t: A solid has 7 faces and 10 vertices. How many edges does it have?
q.e: Faces + vertices − edges = 2, so edges = 7 + 10 − 2.

q.t: A prism has 8 faces. How many sides does its base have?
q.e: Two of the faces are the ends; the other 6 are side faces, one for each side of the base.

q.t: A pyramid has 10 edges. How many faces does it have?
q.e: A pyramid has 2 edges for each side of the base, so the base has 5 sides: 5 triangles + 1 base.

q.t: A 3 × 3 × 3 cube is made from 27 small cubes and painted on the outside. How many small cubes have paint on exactly 3 faces?
q.e: Only the corner cubes show three faces, and a cube has 8 corners.

q.t: A 3 × 3 × 3 painted cube is cut into 27 small cubes. How many have paint on exactly 1 face?
q.e: Only the cube in the middle of each face — one for each of the 6 faces.

q.t: How many small cubes of side 1 cm are needed to build a cube of side 4 cm?
q.e: 4 along each of length, breadth and height: 4 × 4 × 4.

q.t: What is the total number of dots on a dice?
A wire frame of a cube uses 96 cm of wire. Find the length of each edge (in cm).
q.e: A cube has 12 equal edges: 96 ÷ 12.

q.t: A cone standing on its base is cut straight down through its tip. The cut face is a:
q.e: Two slanting edges meet at the tip, with the base’s diameter along the bottom.

q.t: Two identical cubes are joined face to face. How many faces does the new cuboid have?
q.e: It is a cuboid, and every cuboid has 6 faces — the two joined faces disappear inside and the others merge in pairs.
